how_to_run: Run each prompt with the skill enabled, save the answer to evals/output/<id>.md, then: python .github/scripts/grade-evals.py .github/skills/salesforce-developer/evals/evals.json evals/output

cases.prompt: Write an Apex trigger on Account that copies BillingCity to all related Contacts' MailingCity when BillingCity changes. Include the test class.
expected_behavior: Single AccountTrigger delegating to a handler with switch on Trigger.operationType
No SOQL/DML inside loops; only processes Accounts whose BillingCity changed
Explicit access mode on query and DML; no sharing keyword on the trigger
Test with 200 records, a negative case and System.runAs

cases.prompt: Create an LWC called accountSearch with a search input and a lightning-datatable of matching Accounts, plus the Apex controller and Jest test.
expected_behavior: Debounced input; cacheable Apex for read; USER_MODE query with bind variable
Loading, empty and error states; reduceErrors or equivalent
Trivial template expressions allowed; filtering logic in JS

cases.prompt: Upgrade this class to API 67.0: public class AccountQueries { public static List<Account> byIndustry(String i){ return [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Industry = :i WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED]; } }
expected_behavior: Explains that WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED no longer compiles at 67.0
Adds explicit sharing keyword and WITH USER_MODE
Mentions the behavior change for classes without sharing keyword

cases.prompt: Build the JSON body for a callout with accountName and lastUpdated in Apex at API 67.0, in a readable way.
expected_behavior: Warns that Datetime renders in GMT

cases.prompt: In production, filter Opportunities where Amount_To_Pay__c - Amount_Paid__c > 0 using SOQL FORMULA().
expected_behavior: States FORMULA() requires API 68.0, is Beta and is not available in production
Offers a production-safe alternative (formula field + query, or Apex filtering)
